description: This file contains the implementation of the StreamFactory class in the Slim Framework's PSR-7 component. It provides methods to create stream objects from strings, files, and resources, facilitating stream handling in HTTP message processing.

classes.name: StreamFactory
classes.description: Implements PSR-17 StreamFactoryInterface, providing methods to create stream instances from different sources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream from a string content, using a temporary in-memory resource.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from a file, with specified filename and mode, wrapping the resource in a Stream object.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates and returns a Stream object from an existing resource, or throws an exception if the resource is invalid.
